Answer: E
Reason: The coronal CT image (Figure 1) demonstrates a distinct, rounded hyperdense mass located in the lateral aspect of the right mid-lung zone, which corresponds anatomically to the right middle lobe. This lateral positioning and mass effect are consistent with the description of a pseudoaneurysm causing mild displacement of adjacent structures like the right lower lobe bronchus, distinguishing it from medial or upper/lower lobe locations.
